name: counts filled squares at sparse coordinates
input: a far-away two by two square and a singleton component

name: rejects rectangles, L-shapes, and components with holes
input: three connected non-square components in different colors
test:
rectangle = [(x, y, 'R') for x in range(10, 13) for y in range(2)]
l_shape = [(20, 0, 'L'), (21, 0, 'L'), (20, 1, 'L')]
hole = [(x, y, 'H') for x in range(30, 33) for y in range(3) if (x, y) != (31, 1)]
assert count_square_components(rectangle + l_shape + hole) == 0

name: does not merge adjacent components of different colors
input: two same-shaped regions that touch only across a color boundary
